notes.title: Come see us at RetroGameCon in Syracuse!
notes.content:
Interested in The Beard in the Mirror, but aren't sure if you're ready to commit to the $9 price tag just yet? GOOD NEWS! We'll be showing off the game at RetroGameCon, Nov. 18 and 19!

Come play the game and chat about sweet old adventure games with one of the lead developers, Paul Franzen.

The event: http://retrogamecon.com

Hope to see you there!

notes.title: Come see us at the Smithsonian!!
notes.content:
I'm beyond excited to announce that our newest game, THE AWKWARD STEVE DUOLOGY, is going to be exhibited at the Smithsonian American Art Museum in August, as part of the SAAM Arcade! It's happening Aug. 5th and 6th, for anyone who wants to hang out with us in D.C. and play lots of weird indie games!!

The game: http://store.steampowered.com/app/536770/THE_AWKWARD_STEVE_DUOLOGY/
The event: http://americanart.si.edu/calendar/saam-arcade/

Hope to see you there!

notes.title: Need a hint? Tweet our Hint Line!
notes.content:
Stuck on a puzzle? Can't find that one item you need? ...Not even sure where the "walk" button is?

Just tweet the official Oh, a Rock! Hint Line [url=https://twitter.com/beardhints/]@beardhints[/url] with your situation, and we'll get back to you as soon as we can with spoiler-free hints, straight from the developers!

(Note that you can also use the Hint Line for our other entertainment products, such as our visual novel [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/474980]Cat President[/url], although the answer there is likely to be "go back and select the other option".)
